claims: top-level information architecture is deliberately small and defines Today, Discover, Calculate, Records and Profile destinations
Western, Vedic, Chinese, Numerology, Spiritual and Personal Growth remain distinct visible domains
professional tools are hidden from simple mode and become visible only in professional experience mode
first-launch onboarding is limited to a short sequence rather than exposing the full feature catalog
birth date is optional and birth time is modeled explicitly as known or unknown
unknown birth time cannot be replaced by a fabricated default time for time-dependent calculation
time-dependent features can declare and enforce a birth-time dependency with TR/EN user notice
birth place stores display identity, coordinates and IANA timezone as separately validated values
profile fields can be edited while preserving stable profile identity
blocked_until: the production MainNavigationShell is wired to the canonical information-architecture policy and rendered in both TR and EN
real Discover/Calculate domain pages replace remaining feature placeholders
Expert/Professional preference is persisted and exercised through runtime UI
onboarding widgets use this policy and pass phone/tablet accessibility tests
birth-place picker performs real disambiguation and coordinate/timezone verification
all ascendant/house and other birth-time-dependent production routes consume BirthTimeDependency rather than local ad-hoc defaults
clean-checkout/device/lifecycle tests prove unknown-time users never receive fabricated ascendant/house results
